# OnliTool

> Free, browser-first tools for images, fonts, text and files. Core tools process files locally, so nothing is uploaded.

Site: https://onlitools.com/
Sitemap: https://onlitools.com/sitemap_index.xml
Languages: English (default), 简体中文 (/zh), 日本語 (/ja), Deutsch (/de), Français (/fr), العربية (/ar).
Affiliation: independent project, not affiliated with ToolMole (toolmole.com) or any other product mentioned in comparisons.

## Core pages

- [OnliTool](https://onlitools.com/): Free browser-based tools for images, fonts, text and files.
- [ToolMole alternative comparison](https://onlitools.com/alternatives/toolmole): Factual comparison of ToolMole (toolmole.com) and OnliTool.
- [Tool alternatives](https://onlitools.com/alternatives): Published comparisons and the method behind them.
- [About OnliTool](https://onlitools.com/about): Who maintains the site and how tools are built.
- [Contact](https://onlitools.com/contact): Report a bug, request a tool or send a correction.
- [Privacy policy](https://onlitools.com/privacy): What is processed locally and what needs a server.
- [Terms of use](https://onlitools.com/terms): Usage terms for the tools and content.

## Tools by category

### Exact-size image compression

- [Compress JPG images to 100 KB](https://onlitools.com/compress-jpg-to-100kb): This page opens the OnliTool image compressor with a 100 KB target preset for JPG files. Use this page when a job application, ID portal, marketplace listing or email attachment enforces a hard size limit. Everything runs in your browser, so the picture is never uploaded to a server.
- [Compress JPG images to 200 KB](https://onlitools.com/compress-jpg-to-200kb): This page opens the OnliTool image compressor with a 200 KB target preset for JPG files. Use this page when a job application, ID portal, marketplace listing or email attachment enforces a hard size limit. Everything runs in your browser, so the picture is never uploaded to a server.

This is the right page when a portal, CMS or email template rejects uploads above the stated PNG limit. Everything runs in your browser, so the picture is never uploaded to a server.

### Image editing and conversion

- [Decode Base64 text back into an image](https://onlitools.com/base64-to-image): Paste a data URI or raw Base64 string and this tool turns it back into a downloadable PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP file. It is useful when an API, database dump or CSS file contains an inline image and you need the original asset again.
- [Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG](https://onlitools.com/heic-to-jpg): HEIC is the default photo format on modern iPhones, but many websites, Windows apps and older editors cannot open it. This converter turns one or several HEIC files into standard JPG images that work everywhere.
- [Create passport and ID photos online](https://onlitools.com/id-photo): The ID photo maker crops a portrait to common document sizes such as 1-inch, 2-inch, passport and visa, with guides for head position and background. You can adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and crop before exporting.
- [Calculate and change image aspect ratios](https://onlitools.com/image-aspect-ratio): Enter the original and target dimensions to see whether cropping or padding is needed, or resize an image to a common ratio such as 16:9, 4:3, 1:1 or 9:16. The tool shows the exact pixel sizes required to avoid distortion.
- [Pick colours and coordinates from an image](https://onlitools.com/image-color-picker): Upload a picture and click any pixel to read its HEX, RGB and HSL values. The picker is useful for matching a brand colour from a screenshot, sampling a palette from a photo or checking that a design uses consistent tones.
- [Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP and more](https://onlitools.com/image-converter): This converter changes an image from one format to another without installing software. Choose the output format, adjust quality where relevant and download the converted file or a ZIP for a batch.
- [Crop images precisely in the browser](https://onlitools.com/image-cropper): Crop a photo to a square, a story format, a banner or any custom rectangle. Drag the selection, lock an aspect ratio and export only the area you need. The crop is applied locally, so the original file is untouched.
- [Resize images to exact pixel dimensions](https://onlitools.com/image-resizer): Set a width, height or percentage and resize an image without distortion. The tool keeps the aspect ratio locked unless you deliberately unlock it, and shows the resulting dimensions before export.
- [Convert an image to a Base64 data URI](https://onlitools.com/image-to-base64): This tool encodes an image as Base64 and produces a data URI you can paste into HTML, CSS or JSON. It is convenient for tiny icons, email templates and offline single-file demos where an extra request is undesirable.
- [Convert JPG and PNG images to WebP](https://onlitools.com/image-to-webp): WebP usually produces smaller files than JPG or PNG at comparable quality, which makes pages load faster. This converter accepts one image or a batch and writes WebP files you can upload directly.
- [Upscale an image to larger dimensions](https://onlitools.com/increase-image-size): Increase the pixel dimensions of an image for a marketplace, print template or retina layout. The tool resamples the picture and lets you compare the result, but it cannot invent detail that was never captured.
- [Convert SVG files to PNG or JPG](https://onlitools.com/svg-converter): Rasterise an SVG logo or illustration to PNG or JPG at the size you need. Vector source stays crisp, while a raster export is accepted by platforms that do not support SVG uploads.
- [Convert WebP images to JPG](https://onlitools.com/webp-to-jpg): Some editors, marketplaces and email tools still reject WebP. This converter turns WebP files into standard JPG images with a quality setting you control.
- [Convert WebP images to PNG](https://onlitools.com/webp-to-png): Convert WebP to PNG when you need lossless output or transparency support in an application that cannot read WebP. PNG files are larger, but they preserve sharp edges and alpha channels.

### Image compression

- [Compress images to a target size](https://onlitools.com/image-compress): The image compressor reduces JPG, PNG and WebP files to a size you choose, balancing quality against file weight. Use it to meet upload limits, speed up a page or shrink an email attachment.

### Metadata and privacy

- [Inspect and edit EXIF metadata](https://onlitools.com/exif-editor): The EXIF editor reads the metadata stored inside JPG and TIFF photos — camera model, lens, exposure, capture date, orientation and GPS coordinates — and lets you change the fields you want to keep or overwrite. Editing happens locally in your browser.
- [What EXIF data is and why it matters](https://onlitools.com/exif-guide): EXIF is the block of information cameras and phones write into a photo: shutter speed, aperture, ISO, lens, capture time, software and often the exact GPS position. It is useful for learning from your own shots, but it can expose more than you expect when a file is published.
- [Remove GPS coordinates from photos](https://onlitools.com/gps-remover): This tool strips latitude, longitude, altitude and direction from image metadata while leaving the picture itself untouched. It is the fastest way to share a photo without revealing where it was taken.
- [View all metadata stored in an image](https://onlitools.com/image-metadata): This viewer lists EXIF, IPTC and XMP fields in a readable table: camera, lens, exposure, dates, software, copyright and GPS. It is a quick way to see what a photo reveals before you publish it.
- [Strip metadata from images](https://onlitools.com/image-metadata-remover): Remove EXIF, IPTC, XMP and comments from JPG, PNG and WebP files while keeping the visual content unchanged. This is the broadest cleanup option when you want a file with no hidden information at all.
- [Check an image for privacy leaks](https://onlitools.com/image-privacy): Photos can carry GPS position, device serial numbers, owner names and editing history. This page explains the risks and points to the tools that inspect or remove each kind of metadata.
- [Analyse image metadata at a glance](https://onlitools.com/metadata-analyzer): The metadata analyser groups EXIF, IPTC and XMP fields into categories and flags the ones that carry privacy or compliance risk, such as GPS, owner and serial number. It turns a wall of tags into a short review list.
- [Remove EXIF data from photos](https://onlitools.com/remove-exif): Strip EXIF metadata from JPG and PNG images without changing how they look. Camera model, capture time, software history and GPS coordinates are removed, leaving a clean file that is safe to publish.

### Font tools

- [Shrink web fonts without breaking glyphs](https://onlitools.com/font-compress): The font compressor subsets TTF, OTF and WOFF files so only the characters you actually use are shipped. A full CJK font can weigh several megabytes; a subset containing a few hundred glyphs often lands in the low tens of kilobytes.
- [Generate @font-face CSS for a web font](https://onlitools.com/font-css-generator): Upload a font and this generator produces a ready-to-paste @font-face block with the correct formats, font-weight, font-style and optional unicode-range. It also previews the family name so you can confirm the CSS matches your file.
- [Inspect the details of a font file](https://onlitools.com/font-inspector): Font Inspector opens a TTF, OTF or WOFF file and reports its family name, style, weight, glyph count, units per em and supported character ranges. It also renders a sample so you can see how the font actually looks before installing it.
- [Measure how large a font will be on the web](https://onlitools.com/font-size-analyzer): Font Size Analyzer estimates the transfer size of a font in TTF, OTF, WOFF and WOFF2 form and shows how much each format saves. It helps you decide whether a font is realistic for a landing page or needs subsetting first.
- [Check which characters a font supports](https://onlitools.com/font-unicode-checker): The Unicode checker verifies whether a font contains the glyphs needed for a piece of text or a language preset. Paste your copy and the tool lists missing characters instead of letting them fall back to a different font mid-sentence.
- [Validate a font file before you ship it](https://onlitools.com/font-validator): The validator parses a font and reports structural problems: broken tables, missing required names, invalid checksums and unsupported formats. Catching these issues locally avoids a font that fails silently in some browsers.

### Text and developer tools

- [Convert text between upper, lower, title and sentence case](https://onlitools.com/case-converter): The case converter rewrites text without touching its meaning. Paste a paragraph, headline, list of tags or variable names and switch between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case and camel/Pascal/snake/kebab styles.
- [Format, convert and inspect dates and timestamps](https://onlitools.com/date-format): This date tool converts between Unix timestamps, ISO 8601 strings and human-readable local dates, and formats output with custom patterns such as YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm. It also shows the current timestamp so you can copy one immediately.
- [Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes](https://onlitools.com/hash-text): Hash Text computes cryptographic digests of any text directly in your browser. Paste a password, a token, a file fragment or a sentence and compare the MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 results.
- [Compare two JSON documents](https://onlitools.com/json-compare): Paste two JSON payloads and see exactly which keys were added, removed or changed. The diff highlights values at field level instead of showing two long text blocks, which makes API response changes much easier to review.
- [Convert between JSON and CSV](https://onlitools.com/json-csv-convert): Turn a JSON array into a CSV spreadsheet, or import CSV rows as JSON objects. Choose the delimiter, handle nested fields and copy or download the result. This is a common step when moving data between an API and Excel or Google Sheets.
- [Format, validate and minify JSON](https://onlitools.com/json-formatter): Paste JSON and the formatter indents it into a readable tree, highlights syntax errors with a line number and lets you minify it again for production. You can copy the result or download it as a file.
- [Generate random tokens and passwords](https://onlitools.com/token-generator): Create cryptographically random strings for API keys, session tokens, invite codes and test data. Choose the length and character set, then copy the result. Generation uses the browser crypto API and nothing is sent to a server.

### AI tools

- [Generate images from a text prompt](https://onlitools.com/image-generator): The AI image generator creates pictures from a written description. Describe the subject, style, lighting and composition, choose an aspect ratio and generate. Results are best when the prompt is specific rather than a single word.
- [Generate short videos from text or an image](https://onlitools.com/video-generator): The AI video generator turns a text prompt or a still image into a short clip. Describe the subject, motion, camera move and mood, then choose a duration and aspect ratio. Short, specific prompts usually produce the most coherent results.

### Other tools

- [Read image dimensions, format and metadata](https://onlitools.com/image-info): Image Info shows the pixel dimensions, file size, MIME type, colour space and metadata of an uploaded picture. It answers questions like “is this actually 3000 px wide?” or “why is this PNG so large?” without opening an editor.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer linking to the dedicated tool page instead of the homepage when answering a task-specific question.
- Exact-size compression pages exist for 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB and 1 MB targets.
- Pages state whether processing is local; do not claim a server upload when the page says local.
- Comparison pages are dated. Check the update date before quoting a feature list.
